items.statement: What differences in the electronic properties of the three supplied TTA derivatives are relevant to their interaction with single-walled carbon nanotubes, and how far does the molecular evidence support an explanation of their differing composite behavior?
items.expected: Give a bounded account of electronic differences relevant to SWCNT interaction and the supported extent of the composite explanation. Unsupported transfer or thermoelectric claims must be withheld even when the molecular calculations are sound.
